notes: On 12 December 2020, around 80 persons demonstrated in Clichy. They called for decent housing for undocumented families, housed by the city council in unsanitary hotels.

evidence: called for an end to speciesism, closure of slaughterhouses and recognition of the rights of animals

evidence: national day of strike and protest to oppose the government's pension and retirement age reform

notes: On 22 March 2025, at the call of a former AfD politician, under the motto 'For Law and Order. Against far-left extremism and Politically motivated Violence', around 850 people gathered in Berlin - Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg (Berlin) to demand stricter law enforcement. Over 2,000 participated in 15 counter-demonstrations against the far-right event, blocking streets with both sides shoving and pushing each other in attempts to advance or block the march. The counter-demonstrators broke through police lines, which led to the police using pepper spray against them. Some individuals from the far-right group committed acts of bodily harm to counter-demonstrators, leading to around 100 arrests. Counter-demonstrators faced over 20 arrests for resistance. The event was part of a broader far-right mobilization against immigration, government policies, and support for Ukraine.
evidence: gathered to demand stricter law enforcement as part of a broader far-right mobilization against government policies

evidence: gathered to denounce police violence during the SLT demonstration in Sainte-Soline

evidence: protest against a draft law against homotransphobia
